definition_en: to besiege a place with armed forces; to surround someone with troubles
core_image: 城墙四面敌营连绵，城内粮草渐尽
scene: 敌军扎营于四门之外，城内人心惶惶。Rebel forces had beleaguered the capital for months.
sceneCN: 这里 beleaguered 是「围困」（第 1 个义项：以军队围城）；句意是叛军围困首都已经数月。

derivatives.zh: 基础词，义为「围城营地；同盟者」
由过去分词转形容词，义为「被围困的；四面楚歌的」

senses.title: To besiege with an army
senses.definition: to surround a fortified place with armed forces to force surrender
senses.definitionCN: 以军队包围设防之地，迫其投降
senses.example: Rebel forces had beleaguered the capital for months.
senses.exampleCN: 叛军围困首都已经数月。
senses.why: The Dutch root meant to camp, and besiegers camped in a ring round the walls.
senses.whyCN: 荷兰语词根意为「扎营」，围城者在城墙外环营驻扎。

senses.title: To harass with troubles
senses.definition: to surround a person or group with persistent difficulties
senses.definitionCN: 使某人或机构陷于接连不断的困境
senses.example: The scandal left the minister beleaguered on every front.
senses.exampleCN: 丑闻让部长在各条战线上都焦头烂额。
senses.why: Enemies camped round a city became troubles camped round a person.
senses.whyCN: 环城扎营的敌军，化作环人困扰的难题。

intro.en: Beleaguer is Dutch be- plus leger, camp.
intro.cn: beleaguer 由荷兰语 be- 加 leger（营地）构成。

items.en: leger meant a camp or bed.
items.cn: 荷兰语 leger 意为「营地；床铺」。

items.en: belegeren meant to camp round, that is, to besiege.
items.cn: 荷兰语 belegeren 意为「环营围困」。

items.en: beleaguer entered English during the Dutch wars.
items.cn: 十六世纪 beleaguer 随荷兰战事进入英语。

items.en: the figurative sense of being beset by troubles appeared.
items.cn: 十七世纪出现「为困境所困」的比喻义。

items.en: beleaguered is now the commonest form, for cities, teams and governments.
items.cn: 如今 beleaguered 最常用，形容城市、球队与政府。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the be- prefix or the leaguer root; the near-meaning group gathers besieging and harassing words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 be- 前缀或 leaguer 词根；近义组汇集围困与袭扰类词。

entries.definition: a siege camp, or a member of a league
entries.definitionCN: 围城营地；同盟者——beleaguer 的基础词
同盟——与 leaguer 同源的普通名词
围攻——同用 be- 前缀的近义词

entries.definition: to surround militarily or press with questions
entries.definitionCN: 围攻；也指人被纠缠围问

entries.definition: to arrange for battle, or to fortify
entries.definitionCN: 布阵；设防——共享战争语义场

normalIntro.en: Beleaguer is be- plus leaguer: camp round a place.
normalIntro.cn: beleaguer 是 be- 加 leaguer：在某地四周扎营。

normal.en: A beleaguered city is surrounded by an army.
normal.cn: beleaguered city 指被军队围困的城市。

normal.en: The Dutch root leger means camp.
normal.cn: 荷兰语词根 leger 意为「营地」。

normal.en: League comes from the same Germanic root.
normal.cn: league 与之同源（同一日耳曼词根）。

normal.en: Beleaguered by criticism is a common figurative use.
normal.cn: beleaguered by criticism 是常见的比喻用法。

abstract.en: See watchfires ring a city wall by night.
abstract.cn: 看夜里环城而起的篝火。

abstract.en: Feel bread run short and hope run shorter.
abstract.cn: 感受面包渐少、希望更少。

abstract.en: Picture troubles pitching tents round one tired face.
abstract.cn: 想象难题在一个疲惫的脸旁扎下营帐。

examples.en: Rebel forces had beleaguered the capital for months.
examples.cn: 叛军围困首都已经数月。

examples.en: The scandal left the minister beleaguered on every front.
examples.cn: 丑闻让部长在各条战线上都焦头烂额。

examples.en: The beleaguered garrison held out until relief came.
examples.cn: 被围的守军坚持到了援军到来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「比·离隔」——敌人把城围得比隔离墙还严实，正是「围困」。

root: 前缀 be-（荷兰语动词化前缀）加 leger（荷兰语「营地、床铺」，与英语 league 同出日耳曼词根，指「联合扎营」）；荷兰语 belegeren「环营围困」于十六世纪经战事进入英语，十七世纪引申出「为困境所困」的比喻义。

sensesIntro.en: One verb camps armies round a city and troubles round a person.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个动词，既让军队环城扎营，也让难题绕人不去。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: watchfires encircling a walled city at night.
core.cn: 核心意象：夜里环绕城墙的连绵营火。

intro.en: Beleaguer keeps its Dutch verb shape, be- plus leger.
intro.cn: beleaguer 保留荷兰语动词形态：be- 加 leger。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the root is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，词根属日耳曼语源。

由过去分词转形容词，义为「被围困的；四面楚歌的」
